title: Blessed Is That Fortunate Bride, Who Is
summary: The shabad does not leave gratitude at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband
lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is; o Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with
source.lifeApplication: Return begins when the later line is allowed to outlast the first rush of feeling.
